target_state: amorphous: crystalline Si pre-amorphized by inert-gas or Si bombardment (the compilation's Table I, 'a-Si'). Amorphizing species, its dose and the B dose are not given in the source seen

measured.method: SIMS (O2+ probe at 1.5, 2, 3 and 5 keV, normal incidence: four sets, one marker per energy in the figure)

citation: Wach and Wittmaack, Nucl. Instrum. Methods 194, 113 (1982); read from the compilation of Wittmaack and Mutzke, J. Appl. Phys. 121, 105104 (2017)
short_citation: Wach and Wittmaack (1982), via Wittmaack and Mutzke (2017) Fig. 8
source_location: Wittmaack and Mutzke (2017), Fig. 8 (p. 105104-6), filled black circles 'raw experimental data', 11B in Si. Assigned to Wach and Wittmaack (a-Si, 0 deg) by the paper's Table I: no other set listed there goes below 25 keV. The primary paper was not seen (closed access)
extraction: digitized from a figure: the embedded 952 x 733 px, 300 ppi raster of Fig. 8 (pdfimages), log-log axes calibrated by a least-squares line through the five x and four y major-tick centres, each weighted by its black-pixel count (residual <= 0.002 decade); circle centre found by matching a filled disk (radius 7.0 and 7.5 px; the legend marker is 15 px across) against black-or-blue pixels, since the blue fit line crosses each marker; value = mean of the two radii (72.81 and 73.05 nm); energy read as 20 keV within 0.6 %. Second read: the 'selected data (mean) x 0.5' triangles at the same energy agree within 1 % (area centroid) and are about 3 % higher by bounding-box centre. Uncertainty 3.5 %: digitizing 3 % (marker-convention spread about 3 %, tick-centre convention up to 1 %) combined in quadrature with the 1.8 % statistical scatter and < 0.3 % systematic error the compilation reports for this set (p. 105104-7). Delta-Rp is not shown in the figure and is not entered. Script: validation/data/digitize/wm2017_fig8.py
terms: Facts, cited. Measured values digitized from a figure of an AIP-copyrighted article (published version in the Helmholtz Munich repository); only the numbers are stored, no figure. Digitizing counts as copying data and is recorded as such
